insights.one_liner: New Amstelveen climate-focused growth investor founded by ex-ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund leaders, offering an English-language finance internship.

culture.text: Invests in European growth companies in energy transition, sustainable mobility, decarbonising industry, circular materials and bio-based solutions.
Founded by the former leadership team of the ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund; its internship is in Amstelveen.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
Its open finance internship needs no Dutch.

growth.text: Completed the first close of its fund towards the end of 2025.
